presets.title: Using the charts - National
presets.text:
Using the charts

Charts on this page can show data for all the ICSs within the NHS regions in England. However, they are set to show data for a single region and the ICSs within it.

presets.title: Using the charts - NEY
presets.text:
Using the charts

Charts on this page can show data for all the Trusts within each ICS in North East England and Yorkshire. However, they are initially set to show data for a single ICS and the Trusts within it. You can use the dropdown menu at the top of the chart to show data for Trusts within a different ICS or multiple Trusts across more than one ICS.

presets.title: Introduction to adoption curves - Simple
presets.text:
Understanding the adoption curves

You can learn about the adoption curve charts and how we calculate target savings.

Defining adoption curve

There are 3 target adoption curves. They all have a target of 80% adoption, but the time expected to reach 80% varies, depending on the complexity of the molecule.

This molecule is considered to be a simple molecule. The 80% target adoption should be met at 4 months from the contract start date.

presets.title: Denosumab 120mg DDD
presets.text:
Denosumab 120mg

Indications

Prevention of skeletal-related events in adults with bone malignancies and treatment of giant cell tumours of bone

Presentations

Denosumab 120mg is available as pre-filled syringes and vials

Baseline spend

£26 million

Contract start

January 2026

Supply issues

Supplies of the biosimilar 120mg pre-filled syringe (PFS) are being regulated to avoid over-ordering. Supplies of the biosimilar 120mg vial, where available, are being monitored in case of preferential use compared to the PFS going forward. Supply constraints are still affecting some regions.

Defined daily dose

0.33mg

Uptake summary

Regional uptake is now good overall.

Other issues

The savings assumptions and adoption curves have been set using a target price that sits just above all the available biosimilar 120mg products. In some cases this may under-report the maximum savings potential where a regionally awarded 120mg product was available at a lower price. This was unavoidable given the mixture of products in use and the unpredictable market share between the vial and pre-filled syringe presentations.

presets.title: Nintedanib - DDD
presets.text:
Nintedanib

Indications

Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and non-small cell lung cancer

Presentations

Nintedanib is available as 100mg and 150mg capsules

Baseline spend

£92 million

Contract start

May 2026

Supply issues

Not all strengths were available in all regions from the start of tender.

Defined daily dose

380mg

Uptake summary

Generic progress being made in all regions. 

Other issues

Nintedanib has two different indications. For Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis usage is seen at specialist centres only and supply is typically via the homecare route. This is where the vast majority of nintedanib usage comes from.
For non-small cell lung cancer much lower quantities are issued nationally but from a far wider range of Trusts. This usage usually comes via the standard outpatient pharmacy route.

Nintedanib has two different indications. For Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis usage is seen at specialist centres only and supply is typically via the homecare route.
